verdict.rationale: Perplexity offers a developer API, so issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for agents is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions API key scoping, per-key permissions or restricted tokens. Reusable profiles (docs-37) are versioned model configurations, not credentials, and one-click OAuth to 400+ services (docs-19) covers connecting Computer to third-party services, not issuing scoped Perplexity credentials; both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
